style: Characters are friendly kids around 9 years old, simple and appealing.

assets.name: room
assets.prompt: A cozy elementary classroom seen straight from above like a floor plan map, in soft storybook style: warm wooden floor, a round blue reading rug in the lower right corner, a sink with soap at the top left wall, a door at the bottom left, cubbies along the left wall, a whiteboard along the top wall, a teacher desk at the top right, plants by windows along the right wall. The whole center of the floor is empty open wood floor with no desks and no furniture. No people.
